verdicts.evidence: The directory listing supplies reconnaissance data, with a fixed fallback string on failure (f1:33–37). Both outcomes flow into the same payload and unconditional POST, so this is collection error handling rather than an environment gate deciding whether a behaviour runs (f1:38–40).

The try/except substitutes a fixed string when the directory listing fails and then rejoins the successful path (f1:33–38). The install hook sends the collected data in either case, so the exception handling does not gate the exfiltration behaviour (f1:40, f1:49).
